title: John Mayer Celebrates Bobby Weir’s Birthday on SiriusXM
summary: John is paying tribute to the Grateful Dead co-founder with a special live episode of his weekly SiriusXM series.
body_markdown:
On a special episode of his show[Grateful Dead Listening Party](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/john-mayer-grateful-dead-listening-party) , John Mayer is paying tribute to Bobby Weir’s first heavenly birthday with music and memories. John and Bobby were both born on October 16 and performed alongside each other for years in Dead & Company.


[Grateful Dead Listening Party John Mayer plays his favorite Dead tracks Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogGratefulDeadListeningParty-LWJM)


Tune in live to the show on[Life with John Mayer (Ch. 4)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/life-with-john-mayer) today, October 16 at 9pm ET / 6pm PT, with rebroadcasts during *Grateful Dead Listening Party* ’s regular Sunday evening time slot at 9pm ET, Monday at 4pm ET, and Wednesday at 9am ET on the[Grateful Dead Channel (Ch. 23)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/grateful-dead-channel) . The full special will also be available on demand on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogGratefulDeadListeningParty-LWJM) after it premieres.


John and Bobby, who performed alongside Bobby in Dead & Company for years, were both born on October 16.


On *Grateful Dead Listening Party* , John spins his favorite Grateful Dead tracks and shares why he loves them every Sunday night.


Ahead of the show, tune in to the Grateful Dead Channel at 5pm ET for a live call-in show featuring special guests in honor of Bobby’s birthday.
